sasha_csm: Quick alert 3 clients/Crestline-like account drop in prod usage ~80% since 2026-04-10. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/crestline-tenant
metrics-bot: ALERT: crestline-prod requests -80% (72h). No 5xx spike. Top endpoints: /embed, /batch-embed.
drew_sales: They mentioned a vendor test (Nimbus) on last call. I flagged a nose-in-SFDC.
maya_eng: Checked infra 2:00 UTC window no deploys. CPU/latency stable. Token spend down.
support-bot: Ticket #6789 shows client changed client routing and started sending some embeddings to an on-prem vector DB on 2026-04-10. Attachments uploaded.
leo_se: Confirmed: client config flips to local store. Also one sample shows vector dim mismatch that could cause silent drop of embed calls.
sasha_csm: Triage plan proposal: 1) schedule 30m sync with their ML lead; 2) provide short cost + latency comparison; 3) offer a timeboxed Dedicated credit tied to a joint tech session; 4) prep a rollback runbook.
drew_sales: Sales prefers 4-week credit and an A/B pilot offer where heavier traffic stays on our dedicated endpoints for the test window. I'll draft language.
maya_eng: I can run a 30m migration backstop session Tue 9am PT and prepare a 1-page runbook for reverting routing + KV cache tips.
frank_finance: If they request billing relief we need written confirmation of migration and scope. Finance will expedite once provided.
sasha_csm: Actions: Drew  draft credit & A/B proposal; Maya  tech deck + runbook; Leo  attach config evidence & vector-dim note to ticket; Sasha  cost comps and internal renewal note. Set renewal_risk = "elevated" for now.
drew_sales: Invite pending  I'll include procurement and PM.
maya_eng: Uploaded draft runbook to /shared/cs/crestline by EOD.
sasha_csm: Thanks team. Keep updates here; escalate to "high" if usage keeps declining before the sync.
